text: いって　おくが　ボスは　つよいぞ　くれぐれも　きを　つけな

structure.jp: くれぐれも　きを　つけな

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus おく means doing something ahead of time so it is ready for later. いって　おく = 'I'll say this in advance'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: な stuck on the verb with ます cut off is short for なさい, a casual order. Do not mix it up with the 'don't' な, which follows the full plain verb. きを　つけな = 'be careful'.

patterns.name: 〜が (lead-in)
patterns.explanation: が here does not mean 'but'; it just leads from an opening remark into the main point. いって　おくが = 'let me tell you now:'
